source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 first edition Wellcome Collection b30338724
heading: Of the mutuall agreement of Parents
source_scope: Historical marital relationship claims with gender-role stereotyping. No real human relationship/moral predictions.

source_groups.source_group: Original printed CHAP CXXV, mutual parental agreement

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXV Of the mutuall agreement of Parents
claims.historical_meaning: A separate numbered source on parents' relationship begins lower original PDF607 after paternal inheritance chapter.
The author claims a method of judging the relationship between two parents, not their relationships with the native.

source_groups.source_group: Diurnal Sun/Venus and reception for parental bond

claims.historical_meaning: The day-birth condition applies only to a diurnal geniture, not interchangeable with the nighttime branch.
Sun and Venus are the expressly named planets for the diurnal parents' relationship claim.
The author proposes judging parents' alleged relationship from aspects/configuration between Sun and Venus.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or mutuall reception of each other
claims.historical_meaning: Mutual reception is an additional relationship witness, alternative to simple aspect rather than the same measurement.

source_groups.source_group: Diurnal Venus fortunate approaching solar combustion and gender stereotype

claims.historical_meaning: A favorable Venus state is a precondition of a period gender-role claim, not an ethical judgment.
The author explicitly includes Venus applying toward combustion; its exact phase and orbital margin need historical calculation.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Woman will endeavour to please her Husband
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly alleges compliant marital conduct by the wife; period sexism not a validated description of real women.

source_groups.source_group: Diurnal opposite conditions with Venus retrograde, peregrine, separation

claims.historical_meaning: A retrograde Venus is part of the opposite branch, not sufficient alone without source's companion requirements.
Peregrine/afflicted status is an additional companion constraint to the retrograde designation.
Separation from the Sun is a further distinct condition, not identical to combustion.
The author labels wives rebellious/disobedient under these conditions; this is an unsupported and stigmatizing period attribution.

source_groups.source_group: Nocturnal Saturn and Moon as alternate parental significators

claims.historical_meaning: The author specifies a distinct nighttime-nativity rule rather than reusing the diurnal Sun/Venus pair.
Saturn/Moon form the alleged night-birth parent-significator pair.
The relationship between Saturn and Moon is used, not their isolated signs alone.
A favorable aspect of Saturn/Moon is alleged to support parents' good relations.
Lilly predicts mutual parental affection/concord, without corroborated couple observations.
A square Saturn/Moon aspect is named as one alternative alleged sign of marital discord at night.
Opposition Saturn/Moon is a separately named alternative adverse aspect.
The author asserts perpetual parent conflict under the negative aspect; no measured life-long outcome or counterexamples.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the tenth in Opposition to Lord of the fourth
claims.historical_meaning: Opposition of parental house rulers is a separate condition from the Sun/Venus and Saturn/Moon pair.
The original assigns parental discord to the tenth/fourth rulers' opposition, without independent evidence.

source_groups.source_group: Malefic in tenth vs fourth conditional blame

claims.historical_meaning: A malefic tenth-house occupant is alleged to locate parental discord's cause with mother; no real cause established.
The author blames the mother for discord under a tenth-house malefic; historical moral attribution only.
The alternate fourth-house malefic configuration is identified as distinct from a malefic in tenth.
The author instead maligns paternal character in the fourth-house case; no actual person-level moral evidence.

source_groups.source_group: Following printed CXXVI on parent-native affection and Regiomontanus

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXVI Parents mutuall love to Native
claims.historical_meaning: Printed CXXVI begins at original PDF608, a separate parent-to-child affection question.
The subsequent chapter invokes a Regiomontanus father-time derivation; its calculations belong to the next, more complex source batch.
